BigCraftables.Description: Earthy Recolour-matching decorative boulders, bushes, mushrooms, weeds, etc.

BetterCropsMatching.Description: Makes the BigCraftable and static map crops match Cometkins' Better Crops. **BigCraftables must also be set to true for this to show**

EnchantedGrove.Description: Recolor the grass & tree in the enchanted grove warp area

ReplaceFences.Description: Makes the crafted wood and hardwood fences match the Earthy Recolour static fences (changes seasonally). **Disable the fence replacements in SVE's config as they are unnecessary**

Fences.Description: Recolors the small hardwood fence & hedge fence. The small hardwood fence matches the Earthy Recolour static fence (not seasonal) and the Hedge Fence has seasonal Earthy leaves and matching gate

SeasonalEdits.Description: Recolors the seasonal edits (snow piles and leaves) **Disable seasonal edits in SVE's config since unnecessary**

SnowyDebris.Description: Allows you to turn off the snowy debris (sticks, rocks, logs, etc) separately, in case you use a mod that changes their appearance (must also have SeasonalEdits enabled for it to show)

Trees.Description: Earthy Recolour-matching wild (fir & birch), fruit (pear, nectarine, persimmon, money), and static (tall evergreen, mushroom, etc) trees
